title: Social Media Planner sheet template contract
description: F22/F25 — versioned contract for the fleet Social Media Planner template. Defines unique headings, EMPTY starter rows (no brand, campaign or publication content), identity provisioning (client/company title, timezone, schema_version), status color+label pairs (TEXT_EQ conditional formatting, validated dropdowns), the compact This Week view, and frozen/protected formatting. Demonstrations live ONLY in a separate example tab that is never copied into a live client planner. Google template 1RKgS5l-i6NBtf_vON49nBPdHe-F5W67RF9ym-S67L2c is LIVE infrastructure — application is deployment-phase (WF00); this file is the contract scripts/migrate-template.py migrates sheets to.

identity_fields.client_title: Provisioned from verified identity (company registry) — written to the Weekly Overview title cell and the sheet name on copy; never a template placeholder like 'Your Brand'.
identity_fields.timezone: IANA timezone from verified identity (planner-create payload); written to spreadsheet.properties.timeZone at provisioning.
identity_fields.schema_version: This template schema_version, stamped into spreadsheet appProperties at provisioning so migrations and the row-append webhook can version-match.

starter_rows_rule: Starter rows MUST be EMPTY of any brand name, campaign, publication claim (published/scheduled statuses) or progress. A starter row may carry ONLY help text explicitly marked as help. Legacy template content (old campaign rows with Complete/Scheduled/Published statuses) is template starter content and migration blanks it; legitimate client rows/notes are preserved.

Weekly Overview.purpose: Summary derived from the Posts table; legacy 20-column client-facing layout retained.

This Week.purpose: F25 — compact client-facing view (~8 columns): next action, counts, links. Created by the formatting provisioner; client-facing, no operational columns.

Posts.purpose: F23 — normalized per-revision/per-account source of truth. One row per content revision and destination account; upsert on row_key.

Images.purpose: F24 — per-asset manifest + gallery. Preview column P carries trusted =IMAGE("https://…",1) formulas ONLY; all other cells RAW.

Videos.purpose: F38 — per-video evidence: poster image (trusted =IMAGE of the poster CDN URL), duration, ratio, version, QC state, Watch video HYPERLINK (client-bound CC player route) and, after publishing, the actual published URL.

Example (never copy).purpose: F22 — demonstrations ONLY. Clearly named; provisioning and migration NEVER copy this tab into a live client planner. All demo brand/campaign content lives here.

status_colors.description: F25 — every status value gets BOTH a TEXT_EQ conditional format rule (never NUMBER_EQ: statuses are text) and a written label, so color is never the only signal. Dropdowns are enforced with setDataValidation on the same value list.

formatting_contract.conditional_format_rules: TEXT_EQ only for text statuses; NUMBER_EQ is banned for status columns.
formatting_contract.dropdown_validation: setDataValidation ONE_OF_LIST over the status list on every status column, with the dropdown shown.
formatting_contract.frozen_headers: Sheet-level frozen row (1) per tab with headings; Posts additionally freezes its first two columns.
formatting_contract.wrapped_copy: repeatCell wrapStrategy=WRAP on copy/caption columns so long captions stay readable.
formatting_contract.protected_formulas: Protected ranges over formula-bearing cells (Images P column, Posts derived summary cells) so client edits cannot destroy them.
formatting_contract.tab_navigation: Sheet order: This Week, Weekly Overview, Posts, Images, Videos, then operational tabs; the example tab sorts last and is never copied.
formatting_contract.upsert_preserves: Re-running the provisioner/upsert NEVER resets client-changed row sizes or notes; it only repairs structural formatting (rules, validation, freeze, protection).
